# Entire checkpoint samples

These are redacted, trimmed copies of real Entire checkpoint files, taken from public repositories on 2026-10-10 (petercr/ccw, Shaurya002800/PACT and thedannywahl/pantoken).

- **What was changed:** ids are zero-padded and transcript bodies are trimmed. Keys, nesting and value types are unchanged.
- **When they'll be replaced:** by samples captured from this repo's own sessions once those exist.
- **How fixtures use them:** fixture builders copy these shapes. They never invent new keys.
